runningPace.title: Running & Marathon Pace Calculator
runningPace.description: Enter a distance and finish time or pace to calculate your average speed and cumulative splits.

error.distance: Distance must be greater than 0 and at most 500 km, with up to 4 decimal places.
error.time: Finish time must be positive, and minutes and seconds must each be 0–59.
error.pace: Pace must be positive, and seconds must be 0–59.

result.title: Result
result.invalid: Enter a valid distance and finish time or pace.

action.failed: Could not copy. Check your browser clipboard permission.

guide.title: How it works
guide.formula: Average pace (seconds/km) = finish time (seconds) ÷ distance (km), and speed (km/h) = 3,600 ÷ pace (seconds/km). To calculate time from pace, multiply distance by pace.
guide.splits: Each split is calculated from the unrounded time and distance, rather than from the displayed rounded pace. The final row shows the exact finish distance once.
guide.note: This assumes an even pace on a flat course. Actual results vary with the course and conditions.
